Docs.Title: SEC. 1-101. - REFERENCE TO CODE.
Docs.Content:
This Code may at all times be referred to as the "Municipal Code of the City of Fresno" or "Fresno Municipal Code" and whenever cited in an ordinance, may be referred to as "this Code". It shall be sufficient to designate any ordinance adding to, amending or repealing this Code as an addition or amendment to, or repeal of, the "Municipal Code of the City of Fresno" or "Fresno Municipal Code." Also, in any prosecution for the violation of any provision of this Code, it shall be sufficient to designate this Code as the "Municipal Code of the City of Fresno" or "Fresno Municipal Code".

(Orig. Ord. 4789; Am. Ord. 98-62, § 1, eff. 10-1-98; Am. Ord. 2007-55, § 4, eff. 9-4-07).
